title: Daily Chief Inspector Report
contractor: West Tech Energy — Jose Salaises, Director of Operations

sections.heading: Summary of the Day
paragraphs: This morning I met with the project team on the fuel gas tie-in and the routing of the new fuel gas line through the pipe rack. Operations will not allow a shutdown of the existing combustor, so the fuel gas piping is being redesigned. After the meeting I walked the proposed routing down with West Tech. Joel Schweers has issued the IFC isometrics with the affected spools red-lined. Those spools are on hold until Tegre issues the new isometrics, revised BOM and updated P&IDs, and West Tech is continuing on the unaffected spools.

On the civil side, West Tech tied the rebar cages for the pipe supports. We are still waiting on Tegre for the flare anchor bolt detail. West Tech had two welders and two helpers on the job today. Tomorrow will be a half day ahead of the Thanksgiving break.
